lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下一道紫黑的雾。
lines.en: A purple-black haze trails where I walk.

lines.zh: 我不踩地，像从现实里漏出来。
lines.en: I don't step; I leak out of reality.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，影子在墙里穿。
lines.en: I advance and my shadow passes through walls.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有声音，只有雾。
lines.en: My steps make no sound, only mist.

lines.zh: 我从这边消失，从那边出来。
lines.en: I vanish here and emerge there.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，雾就淡一点。
lines.en: With each step the mist thins.

lines.zh: 我绕过火把，走暗的那一侧。
lines.en: I give the torches a wide berth, keeping to the dark side.

lines.zh: 我穿过栅栏，栅栏没有动。
lines.en: I pass through the fence and it does not move.
I see you retreat, and I don't chase.

lines.zh: 我歪着头走，脖子不太对。
lines.en: I walk with my head askew; my neck is not right.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声像有人在你耳边。
lines.en: My breath sounds like someone at your ear.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，雾把草压弯。
lines.en: I skim the ground; mist bends the grass.

lines.zh: 我悬在离地半寸的地方。
lines.en: I hover half an inch above the ground.
Mist coils in a ring at my feet.
I stare at the torch, eyes bright.

lines.zh: 我在数你的影子有几个。
lines.en: I am counting how many shadows you cast.

lines.zh: 我的手指很长，垂到膝盖。
lines.en: My fingers are long, hanging to my knees.
I don't breathe; only the mist moves.
I wait for the mist to clear, then to gather.

lines.zh: 我的脸在雾里看不太清。
lines.en: My face is unclear inside the mist.
I turn my head a full circle.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一点紫光。
lines.en: A fleck of violet light glows in my throat.
Every sound around has gone muffled.
I stand still, and there is another me past the wall.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在墙上，墙也变凉了。
lines.en: I rest my head on the wall and the wall grows cold.

lines.zh: 雾里能听见别人的呼吸。
lines.en: I can hear others breathing inside the mist.
Is it me you see, or the mist?
I lift my head and the mist parts.
Your eyes will fail first.
I am closer than you think.
That one behind you is also me.

lines.zh: 你数错了，我一直有两个。
lines.en: You miscounted; there have always been two of me.
Don't stare; you will stop seeing clearly.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你没在跑。
lines.en: I look at you because you are not running.

lines.zh: 我听见你吸气的节拍乱了
lines.en: I hear the rhythm of your breathing break.
I push the mist to your feet.

lines.zh: 你的火把只能照到一个我。
lines.en: Your torch can only light one of me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，雾里伸出一只手。
lines.en: I raise a hand, and one emerges from the mist.

lines.zh: 你的影子在往我这边偏。
lines.en: Your shadow is leaning toward me.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手指，雾就动了。
lines.en: I lift a finger and the mist moves.
You cannot see my lower half.
Your wick has burned shorter.
I have been at your left hand all along.

lines.zh: 你的影子有两个，一个是我。
lines.en: You cast two shadows. One is me.

lines.zh: 光碰到我，形状散了一点。
lines.en: Light touches me and my shape loosens.
I retreat into the mist.
That cost me one of me.
The mist thins; I gather myself back.
You hit, but not solidly.
You scattered my mist.
The fire is too close; I shrink back.
I recounted myself.
It hurts, like light passing through me.

lines.zh: 雾里传出一声不像人的响。
lines.en: Something unlike a man sounds in the mist.

lines.zh: 我不要果子，我要你手里那盏灯
lines.en: Not the fruit — the lantern in your hand.
Hold your torch higher.
Can I reach that little light?

lines.zh: 你把火放在地上，我就退了。
lines.en: Set the fire down and I will withdraw.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想靠近热。
lines.en: I'm not hungry; I only want the warmth.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西挡不住我。
lines.en: What you hold won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指，缩回去了。
lines.en: I extend one finger, then pull it back.

lines.zh: 光太近了，我的形状在散。
lines.en: The light is too near; my shape is coming apart.
Keep it; I'll watch it.
I am waiting for it to burn out.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀从我胸口穿了过去
lines.en: Your shoulder passes through my chest.
The mist parts, then closes.
My body is very cold.
Your hand went through.
I press close and you shiver.
Don't push; I was never solid.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，影子乱了。
lines.en: We collide and the shadows tangle.
My mist clings to your clothes.
You pull back, and the mist follows.
I move aside; the mist does not.

lines.zh: 我这一族不靠这个延续。
lines.en: My kind does not continue that way.

lines.zh: 你和我之间隔着一层雾。
lines.en: A layer of mist lies between us.

lines.zh: 我会在一块新的地方再出现。
lines.en: I will reappear somewhere new.
Do you want to hold mist?

lines.zh: 我低头，离你很近，但没有温度。
lines.en: I bend close, with no warmth at all.
Don't seek me; I will move on.

lines.zh: 我的影子会留下，人不会。
lines.en: My shadow stays; I do not.

lines.zh: 你记住我的样子就够了。
lines.en: Remembering my shape is enough.
I step back and the mist swallows me.

lines.zh: 我早忘了两个活人该做什么
lines.en: I long ago forgot what two living people do.
My fingers pass through it.
I make it float.
This thing has a little warmth.
I set it inside the mist.

lines.zh: 它掉在地上，我捡不起来。
lines.en: It fell, and I cannot lift it.
I breathe and it slides toward me.
That little flame is mine now.
It goes cold in my hand.
I press it under my shadow.
I keep no objects; I keep people.
You lit a fire. I saw it.
That little glow on you is mine.

lines.zh: 我散成雾，再从你背后聚。
lines.en: I scatter into mist and gather behind you.

lines.zh: 我落定在你背后，不再动
lines.en: I settle behind you and stop moving.

lines.zh: 我出手的时候会带走光。
lines.en: When I strike, I take the light.

lines.zh: 你听见耳边的呼吸了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear breathing at your ear?

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就看不见了。
lines.en: I count to three and you go blind.

lines.zh: 别指望火把，它照不到我。
lines.en: Don't count on the torch; it can't reach me.
I am at your back, very cold.
The mist has already closed around you.

lines.zh: 有一个我在你左边，一个在你右边。
lines.en: One of me is at your left, one at your right.

lines.zh: 你看错了，我从来只有一个。
lines.en: You are mistaken; there was always only one of me.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你的灯就暗了。
lines.en: I step closer and your lamp dims.
Your companions cannot see me.
The fire you lit — I put it out first.
The mist has already sealed the door.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子，一步不落
lines.en: I keep to your shadow, never a step behind.
Step into the light and I withdraw.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，雾一圈圈收紧。
lines.en: I circle you; the mist tightens ring by ring.
I split off another.
The one you hit is false.
Your torch is trembling.
I wait for you to set the fire down.
I hug the wall at your rear flank.

lines.zh: 你每转一次身，就多一个我。
lines.en: Every time you turn, there is one more of me.

lines.zh: 雾从我脚下一直漫到你膝盖
lines.en: Mist spills from my feet up to your knees.

lines.zh: 我在你耳边叫你的名字。
lines.en: I whisper your name at your ear.

lines.zh: 你看见的那个不是真的。
lines.en: What you see is not real.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，雾就往前一尺。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, the mist gains a foot.
You cannot hit mist.

lines.zh: 我把你的火把含在嘴里了。
lines.en: I have your torch in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你听见两个脚步声，只有一个我。
lines.en: You hear two sets of steps and only one of me.
I am waiting for you to set the fire down.

lines.zh: 雾里伸出的手不是我的。
lines.en: The hand in the mist is not mine.
I touch your eyes once.
My fingers are cold.
Your sight goes black, and here I am.
I seize the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你看不见了。
lines.en: It is light, but you cannot see now.
Mist bursts from my sleeve.
I drag you into the mist.
You dropped your torch.
I press against your back, hard.
You missed three times.

lines.zh: 这一击带走了你的方向。
lines.en: That blow took your bearings.

lines.zh: 我碰你一下，笑声才传出来
lines.en: I touch you, and only then does my laughter arrive.

lines.zh: 我抓你的脸，指甲是雾做的。
lines.en: I rake your face with nails made of mist.
Your hand closes on something cold.

lines.zh: 我拧了一下你的方向感。
lines.en: I twist your sense of direction.
Your ears go deaf first.
I seep out of a crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 雾比我早一步挤进门缝
lines.en: The mist slips through the doorway a step ahead of me.
The torchlight flickered.

lines.zh: 你转身之前我就站在这儿
lines.en: I was standing here before you turned around.

lines.zh: 紫黑的雾从地面升起来。
lines.en: Purple-black mist rises from the ground.
The mist knows the way; I follow it back.
This time I chose a corner.
Your lamp is still lit.

lines.zh: 我数了数周围有几个人。
lines.en: I counted how many people are near.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓还在从墙里往外渗
lines.en: My outline is still seeping out of the wall.
The wind parts the mist and brings it back.
I hear talking.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步，你听见的是雾。
lines.en: I have no footsteps; what you hear is mist.

lines.zh: 我离你的火把又近了一格
lines.en: I drift one block nearer to your torch.
There is someone past the wall.
The mist begins at my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，手指多了一节。
lines.en: I raise a hand; it has one joint too many.
It is dark here. Perfect.

lines.zh: 火把光一照，我的雾就化了。
lines.en: The torchlight hits and my mist dissolves.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，落地时已经散了。
lines.en: I fall, and by landing I have scattered.

lines.zh: 水把我冲得很淡，我几乎没了。
lines.en: Water thins me out; I am nearly gone.

lines.zh: 气浪掀开雾，我的形状全乱。
lines.en: The blast tears the mist and my shape scatters.
The arrow passes through, taking a clump of mist.
Spell-light pins me in place.
Too long without a living light.

lines.zh: 雷光一炸，我差点散干净。
lines.en: The lightning flash nearly scatters me entirely.
The void stretches me into a line.
